jobRequisitions.jobDescription: St. Mary's Medical Center is offering a nurse extern position.  Nurse Externs assist in the delivery of patient care under the direction of a Registered Nurse or Licensed Practical Nurse.
jobRequisitions.jobQualifications:
Education Requirements:  Documental proficiency of basic technical skills and current enrollment in an approved school of nursing or a graduate from an approved school of nursing in the process of receiving a temporary permit.

 

Work Requirement:  Each Nurse Extern (RN) must work a minimum twenty-four (24) hours a month, of which twelve (12) hours will occur during the weekend period.  Individual exceptions may be made by the Resource Center Clinical Manager related to school and clinical schedules.

 

Certifications/Skills:  BLS required.  Verbal ability required to communicate with patients and understand instructions received from nursing staff; manual dexterity required to use hands easily and skillfully while aiding patients.

jobRequisitions.jobDescription:
Cabell Huntington Hospital is seeking a full-time MFM Sonographer to work with our Maternal Fetal Medicine Department. 

 

MFM Sonographers are responsible for ensuring and providing quality services in all US tests & procedures performed at the main Perinatal center, 3North and PNC-MU locations of Cabell Huntington Hospital. 

 

Primary responsibilities include: 

  • Receiving, clarifying and/or confirming orders
  • Accurate and timely documentation of procedures/tests
  • Competent understanding and operation of all US equipment
  • Understanding and performance of Disinfection and quality control procedures.
  • Mentoring students and fostering an atmosphere of learning
  • Participating in collection and reporting of data used in performance and process improvement activities
jobRequisitions.jobQualifications:
• High School diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Junior College/Technical School required, Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • Registered sonographer (ARDMS) required. 
  •  OB registry required. 
  • NT/NB certification preferred. 
  • Maternal fetal medicine experience preferred. 

The kind of position-related experience includes:

  • Good working knowledge of anatomy, pathology, medical terminology and application software. Ability to skillfully operate US scanner and related patient support equipment is required.  Adherence to established procedure protocols.
  • Working knowledge of all US examinations, exam preps and other information pertinent to placing orders and verifying appropriateness.
